Sam P.: Heads up — APAC provisioning alert. We're seeing a queue spike in ap-southeast-1 because 20 H100 PCIe units from the latest PO are tied up in an RMA/split-shipment flow. @Natalie (NexaSupply) can you confirm status? AWBs & serials below, we're losing capacity on prod clusters.

Sam P.: ```
AWB: TP123456789SG (partial)
AWB: TP987654321SG (partial)
Serials: H100-AX12, H100-AX13, H100-AX14, H100-AX15, H100-AX16, H100-AX17, H100-AX18, H100-AX19, H100-AX20, H100-AX21, H100-AX22, H100-AX23, H100-AX24, H100-AX25, H100-AX26, H100-AX27, H100-AX28, H100-AX29, H100-AX30, H100-AX31
RMA#: RMA-2026-12345
```

Natalie (NexaSupply): Sorry for the disruption — we've got a customs inspection on the consolidated pallet in Singapore. Depot reports a queue; customs hold is blocking the sea carriage manifest for ~10 units. We can split and air-express 10 high-priority units (same SKU), rest will move by sea (ETA +14 days). Air expedite adds ~$650/unit. Customs clearance fees are separate — uncertain until manifest release.

Natalie (NexaSupply): We also flagged one sub-batch where firmware v1.02 != our standard v1.03. If you need plug-and-play, we can either reflash in our staging (adds 24-36h) or swap for v1.03 units from another pool (requires crossdock).

Maria O.: How long does the staging reflash take? Our autoscaler is already shedding nodes in ap-southeast-1. 20 GPUs down affects queued training and prod inference tails. Need timeline in hours.

Natalie (NexaSupply): Reflash + smoke tests = ~30h typical, plus QA hold. Crossdock swap for identical-firmware units (if available) could be same-day if we air-split and move to SG crossdock, but we need signoff to incur expedite fees.

Alex (Oncall): We can't accept the risk of reflash at crossdock. If any unit comes online with wrong firmware, we'll see degraded kernel loads and memory errors. Full replacement (same SKU + firmware) only. Can you confirm stock to cover 20 full replacements air-forward?

Natalie (NexaSupply): I can confirm availability for 12 immediate replacements by air (next-flight) and 8 the following flight (+24h). Total expedite fee ~ $10,400. We can offer a partial waive: 50% off expedite if Redwood covers customs clearance and handling at SG depot.

Sam P.: We need to balance cost vs risk. Do we have runway to wait 24-36h for the full swap? Maria, what's the SLA impact?

Maria O.: SLA impact: tail latency SLO for inference routes will exceed 99.9% if we lose more than 15 GPUs for >6h. Ops can reroute some traffic but throttling costs us customer impact. If 12 arrive ASAP and we can patch the other 8 within 24h, that's probably acceptable. Need firm ETAs and AWBs for the replacements.

Natalie (NexaSupply): I'll push 12 on next-flight air (AWB: AXAIR111234). The follow-up 8 on AXAIR111235 (+24h). Customs docs (commercial invoice + CN23) will be uploaded in 2h. For the 12, expected door delivery to SG crossdock in 8-12h.

logistics-bot: RMA ticket RMA-2026-12345 updated by Natalie (NexaSupply) — status: split-shipment initiated; expedite option selected; tracking added. Link: https://rma.nexasupply.example/RMA-2026-12345

Sam P.: Please attach the courier POs and the revised manifest. Also confirm insurance value for air (we need full coverage; vendor claims standard 110% invoice).

Natalie (NexaSupply): Insurance set to 110% by default. I'll attach courier POs now and add manifests. One more note: if Redwood chooses to refuse expedite costs, we can still move 20 units by sea once customs clears (~+10–14 days), but that will push provisioning well past acceptable window.

Alex (Oncall): Confirmed — we accept the 12+8 air split. Redwood will cover customs clearance charges at SG depot; please send the invoice for customs & handling and the expedited fee split (we'll pay 50% of expedite per your offer). No reflash at crossdock.

Natalie (NexaSupply): Understood — proceeding with air-split. I'll DM the invoice to Sam and finance. Expect attached AWBs and manifests in 15–30m. Apologies for the disruption, we'll prioritize the shipment and mark as priority handling. :ship: :white_check_mark:

Sam P.: Thanks — once AWBs are attached I'll update capacity plan and notify infra. Maria/Alex, tag me if any further regressions.

Alex (Oncall): I'll monitor cluster health and open a temporary quota to hedge until units are live.

Maria O.: Noted. Keep us posted on customs clearance.

Natalie (NexaSupply): AWBs uploaded to RMA ticket and sent to Sam. Closing loop here — I'll post final delivery ETA updates to the thread.
